prompt:
A wide establishing vista of Cairo in a far-future cyberpunk world — environment key art for a game world map, with no people.

The place: Cairo two centuries from now, a far-future megacity along the Nile: the river running through the city in glowing lanes, silent hydrofoils and quiet flying vehicles gliding above it; on the plateau to the west the three great pyramids kept exactly as they stand, each ringed by a slow halo of light, a pale beam rising from the apex of the greatest toward the stars; far-future towers of white stone and glass rising in stepped terraces, their facades traced with glowing lotus and papyrus patterns and screened with lattices of light; the old city of a thousand minarets kept whole beneath a vast clear canopy, its domes and slender minarets glowing gold, under a clear deep-indigo night sky full of stars.

Composition: a sweeping view from a high vantage point at a three-quarter angle, layered depth — framing elements in the near foreground, the city spread across the middle ground, mountains and sky far behind. The whole city reads at a glance as one memorable skyline. Keep the lower quarter of the picture calm and slightly darker (water, terrace or treetops without detail clutter) so interface cards can sit over it.

Style: painterly environment key art matching Korean MMORPG character artwork — 2D painting with visible brushwork, layered strokes of colour, soft broken edges, a few crisp accents; rich atmospheric perspective and luminous light.

No people, no characters, no animals in focus; no text, letters, numbers, signs, logos or watermark; no frame or border.

Output: one horizontal 3:2 image, 1536×1024.
